title: Flourless Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Step 1: Mix peanut butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla together until well combined.
Step 3: Scoop dough onto a baking pan.
Step 5: Transfer straight to the fridge to set.
notes: Flourless recipe from an Instagram reel by @lotsamiles. Exact amounts of vanilla and chocolate chips weren't specified in the source — use to taste.
